mapper.select: SELECT FROM kb_documents WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_documents SET status = 'deleting', enqueued_at = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status <> 'deleting'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM kb_documents WHERE status = 'queued' AND (enqueued_at IS NULL OR enqueued_at < #{before}) ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM kb_documents WHERE status = 'deleting' AND (enqueued_at IS NULL OR enqueued_at < #{before}) ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM kb_documents WHERE status = 'processing' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < #{now} AND (enqueued_at IS NULL OR enqueued_at < #{before}) ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_documents SET status = 'processing', lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, attempts = attempts + 1, next_attempt_at = NULL, enqueued_at = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND version = #{version} AND (status IN ('queued', 'stale') OR (status = 'processing' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now})))

UPDATE kb_documents SET status = 'ready', chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, attempts = 0, lease_until = NULL, next_attempt_at = NULL, enqueued_at = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND version = #{version} AND status = 'processing'

UPDATE kb_documents SET status = 'queued', lease_until = NULL, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, enqueued_at = #{enqueuedAt}, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND version = #{version} AND status = 'processing'
